title: Double Fatou: the iterated liminf of sequential left window quotients is finite a.e.
statement: Let ν_j (j ∈ ℕ) be Borel measures on ℝ, and let Λ ∈ [0, ∞) satisfy ν_j(ℝ) ≤ Λ for every j. For j, n ∈ ℕ and t ∈ ℝ let Q_{j,n}(t) := (n + 1)·ν_j((t − 1/(n + 1), t)) ∈ [0, ∞]. Here n + 1 is read in [0, ∞] and 1/(n + 1) in ℝ. Then for Lebesgue-almost every t ∈ ℝ, liminf_{j→∞} liminf_{n→∞} Q_{j,n}(t) ≠ ∞. Both limits inferior are taken in [0, ∞] along atTop in ℕ.
lean_statement: ∀ (ν : ℕ → Measure ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0∞), Λ ≠ ∞ → (∀ j, ν j univ ≤ Λ) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), liminf (fun j => liminf (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ≥0∞) + 1) * ν j (Ioo (t - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) t)) atTop) atTop ≠ ∞
